header: Creating and managing Amazon OpenSearch Service domains
content:
domains
This chapter describes how to create and manage Amazon OpenSearch Service domains. A domain
is the AWS-provisioned equivalent of an open source OpenSearch cluster. When you create a
domain, you specify its settings, instance types, instance counts, and storage allocation. For more
information about open source clusters, see Creating a cluster in the OpenSearch documentation.
Unlike the brief instructions in the Getting started tutorial, this chapter describes all options and
provides relevant reference information. You can complete each procedure by using instructions for
the OpenSearch Service console, the AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), or the AWS SDKs.
